verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's "Docs for AI Agents" page says every API is described by an OpenAPI spec and lists thirteen downloadable specs under docs.mixpanel.com/openapi/, also indexed in llms.txt. The Ingestion spec itself downloads as a valid OpenAPI 3.0.2 YAML document. The probe's 404s only cover guessed root paths, not the documented /openapi/ location, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the other twelve specs download and are complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
